logic_errors.requirement: Write the actual phone sending-chain telemetry gap into the plan; do not invent missing evidence.
logic_errors.finding: The plan says P2P registration/send/unregister failures are not connected to an existing emitWearError. No emitWearError exists in current production source. Current SDK Task/synchronous failures do invoke describe, which captures and calls diagnostics.record; the missing evidence is successful stages, integer SendResult and receive/drop events, not all SDK failure logging.
logic_errors.required_change: Describe which existing failures are journaled and which callbacks/stages remain unobserved. Preserve the existing exception channel and avoid treating error_tail zero growth as proof of no SDK failures.

logic_errors.requirement: The proposed diagnostic-only iteration freezes retry counts and timeout behavior.
logic_errors.finding: The plan incorrectly specifies an original 15-second READY cutoff. Fifteen seconds is the install/register stage timeout; hello schedules a 5-second timer and permits three retries. With no READY or earlier failure, sends are at approximately 0/5/10/15 seconds and READY exhaustion at 20 seconds. Ending collection at 15 seconds misses the fourth attempt's terminal timeout; implementing that cutoff would change frozen behavior.
logic_errors.required_change: Separate install/register 15-second timers from the existing 5-second-per-HELLO, four-attempt READY sequence. Observe its actual terminal event without introducing a new deadline.

logic_errors.requirement: Repair only an evidenced responsibility boundary; no blind phone lifecycle or subscription changes.
logic_errors.finding: The decision table treats REG_TASK_FAIL or any UNREG/CLOSE after HELLO as evidence to repair that phone boundary. Current fail and cancel intentionally unregister, including normal cleanup after READY exhaustion. Thus a valid timeout-induced UNREG satisfies this row even when it is only a consequence of the native sending failure, not its cause.
logic_errors.required_change: Require same-generation causal ordering showing an unexpected registration failure or premature teardown before the relevant READY attempt, excluding authorized cancel/normal timeout cleanup. Otherwise retain root unknown and collect more evidence; any repair still needs separate authorization.

Keep unique root-cause diagnosis and repaired handshake explicitly unresolved. Diagnostics-only delivery is a scoped evidence/plan stop, not completion of the user's repair goal.
